name: SiteSuperCharger
author: AnAdminer

sections.description:
SiteSuperCharger helps your website look as attractive as possible to search engines helping you to acheive the highest search engine rankings.

Contact Marketing Heroes (https://www.mheroes.com) to get started!
sections.installation:
Install SiteSuperCharger via the plugin directory, or by uploading the files manually to your server. After activating SiteSuperCharger, you’ll need to enter your GUID at Settings -> SiteSuperCharger

For info about acquiring a GUID for SiteSuperCharger visit https://www.mheroes.com.
sections.faq:
Is SiteSuperCharger free?

You must purchase Search Engine Optimization services from Marketing Heroes (https://www.mheroes.com) to use SiteSuperCharger
sections.changelog:
5.5.20

Release date: Apr 23rd, 2026

  • Plugins tab: severity-tiered audit alerts (danger/warning/info) flag dangerous, conflicting, duplicate, and orphaned plugin installs with a summary banner + per-row chips.
  • Orphan plugin directory scanner surfaces .disabled, .old, .bak, .pre-*, and .orig leftover folders under wp-content/plugins.
  • Plugin audit results piggyback on the daily heartbeat so the app sees fleet-wide audit state.
  • Plugins tab “Updated” column shows month + 2-digit year (e.g. Apr '25) for clarity across release years.
  • Sitemap tab: merged XML sitemap + provider rows into a single row with the full URL, removed non-functional toggle button.

5.5.19

Release date: Apr 23rd, 2026

  • og:video tags for blog posts with embedded YouTube/Vimeo (og:video, og:video:type, og:video:width/height).
  • preconnect hints for Google Maps on landing pages (maps.googleapis.com + maps.gstatic.com).
  • preconnect hints for YouTube/Vimeo on blog posts with detected video embeds.

5.5.18

Release date: Apr 23rd, 2026

  • Twitter/X Card meta tags on all landing pages and blog posts (twitter:card, twitter:title, twitter:description, twitter:image).
  • Blog post Open Graph completeness: og:type=article, og:url, og:locale, og:site_name, article:published_time, article:modified_time, article:author, article:section, og:image:width/height.
  • Landing page og:image:width + og:image:height via WP attachment lookup for richer social previews.
  • AI Crawler Policy settings card in v6 Security tab – editable with live AJAX save and robots.txt sync.

5.5.17

Release date: Apr 22nd, 2026

  • SiteHealth hourly cron: POSTs plugin/WP/PHP version, content integrity, CF state, audit queue, and conflicting plugin list to app.
  • SiteContentCount: fetches expected page/blog/FAQ counts from app for integrity comparison.
  • SiteCommands polling: 5-min cron fetches + executes remote commands (purge_cache, fetch_settings, push_health, rebuild=incremental sync only).
  • BlogPosting ImageObject: featured image now emits full ImageObject with pixel dimensions for Article rich results.

5.5.16

Release date: Apr 22nd, 2026

  • Speed tab: per-site PHP HTML minifier toggle (stopgap for CF minify conflicts).

5.5.15

Release date: Apr 22nd, 2026

  • Minifier null-guard: PCRE backtrack overflow now falls back to original HTML instead of returning empty response.
  • Changed minifier default to disabled to prevent regressions on auto-update.

5.5.14

Release date: Apr 22nd, 2026

  • Cloudflare cache purge scoped to www + apex domain only — never subdomains.
